t options that are premature, incomplete, outside scope or less aligned to the objective.</span></div><div><b>04 · Defend</b><span>Choose one answer. Explain why it beats the strongest remaining distractor.</span></div></div><label class="desk-reason-label" for="desk-my-reason">Why is your answer best?</label><textarea id="desk-my-reason" class="desk-reason" rows="2" placeholder="Write your decisive fact and why other options fail (private to this browser)…">${safe(selfReason)}</textarea><p class="desk-tip">Use × to rule out an option. Record the decisive fact—not just the letter you chose.</p></div>`}
function annotatedReview(o,q){const p=COACH[o.code],dir=directive(q),specific=PRECISION[o.code]?.find(c=>c.id===q.id);return `<div class="desk-walkthrough"><div class="desk-direct-feedback"><b>${selected===q.correct?'You chose the best-supported answer.':'Why your answer does not fit'}</b><p>${rich(q.options[selected]?.[1]||q.principle,o.code)}</p></div><h4>Explain the decision</h4><ol><li><b>Read the directive:</b> ${safe(dir.word)} — ${safe(meaning[dir.word]||meaning.BEST)}</li><li><b>Find the rule:</b> ${rich(q.principle,o.code)}</li><li><b>Eliminate A–D:</b> ${rich(specific?.test||'Compare each answer with the stated requirement and authority.',o.code)}</li><li><b>Test the twist:</b> ${rich(specific?.flip||p.change,o.code)}</li></ol>${selfReason.trim()?`<div class="desk-reflection"><b>Your reasoning:</b> ${safe(selfReason)}<p>Compare your explanation with the rule and each option below. Was your justification about the decisive requirement?</p></div>`:''}<div class="desk-elimination-results">${q.options.map(([answer,reason],i)=>`<div class="${i===q.correct?'preferred':'rejected'}"><span>${'ABCD'[i]} · ${i===q.correct?'Keep':'Eliminate'}</span><p><b>${safe(answer)}</b></p><p>${rich(reason,o.code)}</p></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="desk-judge"><b>How well did you reason?</b><div>${[['redo','Need to retry'],['partial','Nearly'],['secure','Can defend it']].map(([v,t])=>`<button type="button" data-desk-action="rate" data-code="${v}" class="${reviewScores[q.id]===v?'active':''}">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div></div></div>`}

function rightPoints(o){let a=ATLAS[o.code],bits=allFamilies(o);let q=scoreContext(o)[currentQuestion]||scoreContext(o)[0];const detailed=MODULE_APPLICATION[o.code]||[];const precision=PRECISION[o.code]||[];const clinicLinks=precision.length?`<div class="precision-side-links">${precision.map((x,i)=>`<button type="button" data-desk-action="jump-precision" data-code="${i}"><b>◈ ${safe(x.title)}</b><small>Mechanics, boundaries, fact changes and a scored case ↗</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`:'';const testable=detailed.length?`<div class="app-angle-links">${detailed.map((v,i)=>`<button data-desk-action="jump-app" data-code="${i}" type="button"><b>${i+1}. ${safe(v[0])}</b><small>${safe(v[2])}</small><span aria-hidden="true">Open note ↗</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`:`<ol>${bits.map(x=>`<li>${safe(examPrompt(x))}</li>`).join('')}</ol>`;return `${decisionPlaybook(o)}
${questionBlock(o,q)}
<section class="desk-card desk-test-points"><h3><span class="desk-marker">▤</span>Testable angles</h3>${testable}<p class="desk-best-rule"><b>Decision test:</b> ${rich(a[1],o.code)}</p></section>
${clinicLinks}<section id="desk-exam-traps" class="desk-card desk-traps"><h3><span class="desk-marker">⚠</span>Common traps</h3><p>${rich(o.notes.trap,o.code)}</p><p>${rich(a[2],o.code)}</p></section>
<section class="desk-card desk-best"><h3><span class="desk-marker">◎</span>What makes an answer strongest?</h3><p>${rich(o.notes.checkpoints||o.notes.compare,o.code)}</p><p>${rich(o.notes.angles?.split('HOW THE DECISION CAN BE TESTED')[1]?.split('WORKED SITUATION')[0]?.trim()||a[1],o.code)}</p></section>
${caseFamilyBlock(o)}`}
function questionBlock(o,q){if(!q)return '';
return `<section id="desk-active-question" class="desk-card desk-question"><div class="desk-question-bar"><h3><span class="desk-marker">?</span>Practice the decision</h3><span>${currentQuestion+1} / ${scoreContext(o).length}</span></div>${questionIntent(q)}<p class="desk-stem">${rich(q.stem,o.code)}</p>
${!revealed?decisionWorkbench(o,q):''}
<div class="desk-choices" role="group" aria-label="Answer options">${q.options.map(([t],i)=>`<div class="desk-option-row"><button type="button" data-desk-action="answer" data-code="${i}" class="desk-option ${selected===i?'chosen':''} ${removed.has(i)?'desk-struck':''} ${revealed&&i===q.correct?'correct':''} ${revealed&&selected===i&&i!==q.correct?'incorrect':''}" ${revealed?'disabled':''} aria-pressed="${selected===i}"><b>${'ABCD'[i]}</b><span>${safe(t)}</span>${revealed&&i===q.correct?'<span aria-hidden="true">✓</span>':''}</button>${!revealed?`<button type="button" class="desk-eliminate-btn ${removed.has(i)?'active':''}" data-desk-action="eliminate" data-code="${i}" aria-label="${removed.has(i)?'Restore':'Eliminate'} option ${'ABCD'[i]}">${removed.has(i)?'↶':'×'}</button>`:''}</div>`).join('')}</div>
${!revealed?`<button type="button" class="desk-check-answer" data-desk-action="check" ${selected===null?'disabled':''}>Check answer and explain A–D</button>`:
`<div class="desk-explanations" role="status"><strong>${selected===q.correct?'Correct decision.':'Learn from this one.'} Best answer: ${'ABCD'[q.correct]}</strong>${annotatedReview(o,q)}</div>`}
<div class="desk-question-foot">${revealed?`<button type="button" data-desk-action="retry">↺ Retry this question</button>`:''}<button type="button" data-desk-action="other-question">${scoreContext(o).length>1?'Next scenario →':'Another objective scenario →'}</button><button type="button" data-desk-action="exam" data-code="${o.domain}">Domain ${o.domain} practice ↗</button></div></section>`}
function domain4Map(o){if(o.domain!==4)return '';
 const steps={
 '4.1':[['Untrusted client','Source traffic'],['Border + DMZ','Entry boundary'],['Application zone','Approved flows'],['Data zone','Least access']],
 '4.2':[['Managed device','Identity & health'],['802.1X / NAC','Admit or quarantine'],['Segment + FW','Enforce paths'],['Monitor / HA','Detect & survive']],
 '4.3':[['Named remote party','Approved purpose'],['MFA + JIT','Verify & constrain'],['Encrypted channel','Validate peer'],['Gateway / app','Audit action']]};
 const pivots={
 '4.1':[['IP packet vs application permission','Reachability does not grant data access'],['TLS vs IPsec vs MACsec','App session vs routed network vs link'],['IPv4 vs IPv6','Every enabled stack needs policy'],['Data vs control vs management','Forwarding is not configuration authority']],
 '4.2':[['802.1X vs EAP vs RADIUS','Port admission vs auth method vs backend'],['NAC identity vs posture','Known is not necessarily safe'],['IDS vs IPS','Alert vs inline enforcement'],['Redundant nodes vs independent paths','Shared failure can defeat both']],
 '4.3':[['HTTPS vs webhook authenticity','Server TLS does not verify caller'],['Private MPLS vs encryption','Isolation is not secrecy'],['VPN vs narrow app access','Transport is not least privilege'],['SIP-TLS vs SRTP','Signalling differs from media']]};
 const refs=o.code==='4.1'?[
 ['ISC2 2024 CISSP objectives','https://www.isc2.org/certifications/cissp/cissp-certification-exam-outline'],
 ['NIST SP 800-207 · Zero Trust','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/207/final'],
 ['RFC 8446 · TLS 1.3','https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8446'],
 ['RFC 9000 · QUIC','https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9000']]:o.code==='4.2'?[
 ['NIST SP 800-153 · Wi-Fi security','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/153/final'],
 ['NIST SP 800-207 · Zero Trust','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/207/final']]:[
 ['NIST SP 800-77r1 · IPsec VPNs','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/77/r1/final'],
 ['NIST SP 800-52r2 · TLS','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/52/r2/final'],
 ['RFC 8446 · TLS 1.3','https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8446'],
 ['RFC 9001 · QUIC 0-RTT and replay','https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9001']];
 const sourceNote=`<details class="d4-standards"><summary>◉ Verify with primary technical standards <span>current editions may evolve</span></summary><div>${refs.map(([name,url])=>`<a href="${safe(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${safe(name)} ↗</a>`).join('')}<p>Official topics and primary references. Original explanations and practice questions are not ISC2 examination items; examples are not a substitute for approved production design.</p></div></details>`;
 return `<section class="desk-card d4-network" id="desk-network-map"><div class="d4-top"><span>NETWORK DECISION MAP · OBJECTIVE ${safe(o.code)}</span><b>Trace the trust boundary</b></div><div class="d4-network-flow">${steps[o.code].map(([a,b],i)=>`<div class="d4-step"><b>${safe(a)}</b><small>${safe(b)}</small></div>${i<3?'<div class="d4-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</div>':''}`).join('')}</div><div class="d4-pivots"><div class="d4-pivot-head">CONCEPTS THAT CHANGE THE ANSWER</div>${pivots[o.code].map(([a,b])=>`<div class="d4-pivot"><strong>${safe(a)}</strong><span>${safe(b)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="d4-jumps"><button type="button" data-desk-action="open" data-code="4.1">4.1 Architecture</button><button type="button" data-desk-action="open" data-code="4.2">4.2 Components</button><button type="button" data-desk-action="open" data-code="4.3">4.3 Channels</button><span>Choose the required protection, then examine its blind spot.</span></div>${sourceNote}</section>`;
}
function domain5Map(o){if(o.domain!==5)return '';
 const lanes={
 '5.1':[['Claim','Who seeks access?'],['Resource','Which asset & data?'],['Permit','Action, purpose, scope'],['Enforce','Physical + logical']],
 '5.2':[['Register','Prove identity'],['Bind','Enroll authenticator'],['Authenticate','Verify control'],['Recheck','Context + session']],
 '5.3':[['Partner IdP','Trust + keys'],['Assertion','Issuer, time, audience'],['Relying party','Map identity + roles'],['Resource','Enforce local policy']],
 '5.4':[['Request','Subject + object + action'],['Policy engine','PDP evaluates facts'],['Enforcement','PEP allows / denies'],['Evidence','Obligations + audit']],
 '5.5':[['Join','Prove + approve'],['Move','Remove old rights'],['Leave','Revoke all paths'],['Verify','Reconcile actual grants']],
 '5.6':[['Authenticator','Factor + protected key'],['Protocol','Origin & replay binding'],['Session','Token, scope & expiry'],['Recovery','Strongest fallback']]};
 const pivots={
 '5.1':[['Badge vs actual person','A credential is not presence verification'],['Network admission vs data rights','Connectivity does not grant every action'],['Need-to-know vs administration','A server admin may not read its data']],
 '5.2':[['IAL vs AAL vs FAL','Proofing vs login vs federation'],['MFA vs phishing resistance','Manually entered OTP can be relayed'],['SSO vs authorisation','Central sign-in does not grant resources']],
 '5.3':[['SAML vs OIDC vs OAuth','Assertion vs login layer vs API delegation'],['SCIM vs SSO','Account lifecycle vs authentication'],['Signed vs valid for this RP','Issuer, audience, time and replay all matter']],
 '5.4':[['RBAC vs ABAC','Job function vs dynamic attributes'],['PDP vs PEP','Make a decision vs enforce it'],['Authenticated vs entitled','Login does not grant object ownership']],
 '5.5':[['Mover = add AND remove','Accumulation is not a correct transfer'],['Deactivate vs revoke','Sessions and API tokens can survive'],['Dormant vs orphaned','Low activity alone is not an owner review']],
 '5.6':[['Kerberos TGT vs service ticket','Ticketing is not blanket resource access'],['Valid signature vs fresh request','Add audience and replay checks'],['Primary sign-in vs fallback','Recovery must not become weaker login']]};
 const refs=o.code==='5.3'?[['ISC2 · current CISSP outline','https://www.isc2.org/certifications/cissp/cissp-certification-exam-outline'],['NIST SP 800-63C-4 · federation','https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-4/sp800-63c.html'],['IETF RFC 9700 · OAuth security','https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9700.html']]:o.code==='5.2'||o.code==='5.6'?[['ISC2 · current CISSP outline','https://www.isc2.org/certifications/cissp/cissp-certification-exam-outline'],['NIST SP 800-63B-4 · authenticators','https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-4/sp800-63b.html'],['NIST SP 800-63A-4 · proofing','https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-4/sp800-63a.html']]:[['ISC2 · current CISSP outline','https://www.isc2.org/certifications/cissp/cissp-certification-exam-outline'],['NIST SP 800-207 · zero trust','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/207/final'],['NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 · access controls','https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/53/r5/upd1/final']];
 return `<section id="desk-iam-map" class="desk-card d5-map"><div class="d5-head"><span>IDENTITY DECISION FLOW / ${safe(o.code)}</span><strong>What must be trusted?</strong></div><div class="d5-flow">${lanes[o.code].map(([t,v],i)=>`<div class="d5-step"><b>${safe(t)}</b><small>${safe(v)}</small></div>${i<3?'<span class="d5-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>':''}`).join('')}</div><div class="d5-contrasts"><div class="d5-contrast-head">THREE EXAM DISTINCTIONS THAT CHANGE THE DECISION</div>${pivots[o.code].map(([a,b])=>`<div class="d5-contrast"><strong>${safe(a)}</strong><span>${safe(b)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="d5-nav">${Object.keys(lanes).map((code)=>`<button type="button" data-desk-action="open" data-code="${code}" ${o.code===code?'aria-current="page"':''}>${safe(code)}</button>`).join('')}<span>Find the failed boundary before choosing a control.</span></div><details class="d5-sources"><summary>Standards and study boundaries <span>primary references</span></summary><div>${refs.map(([label,url])=>`<a href="${safe(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${safe(label)} ↗</a>`).join('')}</div><p>Original practice, not official ISC2 questions. The ISC2 2024 outline applies in 2026; NIST 800-63 Revision 4 was released in 2025. Separate newer engineering guidance from the exam outline.</p></details></section>`;
}
function body(){const o=currentObj(),i=objectives.findIndex(x=>x.code===o.code);opened[o.code]=Date.now();persist();let acr=termsIn(o);let related=neighbors(o);let topics=allFamilies(o);
return `<div class="desk-root"><div class="desk-breadcrumb"><span>CISSP 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">›</span><button data-desk-action="domain" data-code="${o.domain}">Domain ${o.domain}: ${safe(o.domainName)}</button><span aria-hidden="true">›</span><b>${o.code}</b><div class="desk-page-count">${i+1} / 62 <span class="desk-mini-meter"><i style="width:${(i+1)/62*100}%"></i></span></div></div>
${domainTools(o)}${studyLinks(o)}<div class="desk-two-panel"><article id="desk-notes-panel" class="desk-paper"><header class="desk-panel-title desk-left-title"><span aria-hidden="true">✎</span><h2>Simple Notes</h2></header><div class="desk-paper-inner"><div class="desk-topic-head"><span class="desk-obj-tag">Objective ${o.code}</span><h1>${safe(o.title)}</h1></div>
${miniConcept(o)}
${knowledgeEssentials(o)}
${domain4Map(o)}
${domain5Map(o)}
${applicationSection(o)}
${intensiveRevision(o)}${precisionSection(o)}
${depthSection(o)}
<section class="desk-card desk-why"><h3><span class="desk-num">2</span>Why it matters</h3><p>${rich(sentencesText(o.notes.how,3),o.code)}</p></section>
<section class="desk-card desk-example"><h3><span class="desk-num">3</span>Quick example</h3>${exampleVisual(o)}<p>${rich(o.notes.scenario,o.code)}</p></section>
<section class="desk-card desk-remember"><h3><span class="desk-num">4</span>Remember</h3><p>${rich(o.notes.compare,o.code)}</p><p class="desk-recall"><b>Check yourself:</b> ${rich(o.notes.recall,o.code)}</p></section>
<section class="desk-card desk-topics"><h3><span class="desk-marker">◇</span>Topics in this objective</h3><div class="desk-topic-chips">${topics.map((t,k)=>`<button type="button" class="desk-topic-chip ${topicOpen===k?'active':''}" data-desk-action="topic" data-code="${k}" aria-expanded="${topicOpen===k}">${safe(t)}</button>`).join('')}</div>${topicOpen!==null&&topics[topicOpen]?`<div class="desk-focus"><b>${safe(topics[topicOpen])}</b><p>${rich(sentencesText([o.notes.core,o.notes.how,o.notes.deep].find(t=>t.toLowerCase().includes(topics[topicOpen].toLowerCase().split(/[;,/]/)[0]))||o.notes.core,3),o.code)}</p></div>`:''}</section>
<details class="desk-card desk-full"><summary><span>Full notes · all 10 sections</span><span>Expand ↓</span></summary><div class="desk-full-inner">${[['core','Core meaning'],['how','How it works'],['scenario','Practical scenario'],['compare','Compare and distinguish'],['trap','Exam traps'],['recall','Recall'],['deep','Deeper mechanics'],['worked','Worked decision'],['checkpoints','Exam checkpoints'],['angles','Exam angles']].map(([k,t])=>`<section><h4>${t}</h4>${String(o.notes[k]||'').split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean).map(p=>`<p>${rich(p,o.code,new Set())}</p>`).join('')}</section>`).join('')}</div></details>
${lessonCasebook(o)}
<section id="desk-related-concepts" class="desk-card desk-related"><h3><span class="desk-marker">⇄</span>Related notes</h3><div class="desk-related-list">${related.map(x=>`<button type="button" data-desk-action="open" data-code="${x.code}"><b>${x.code}</b><span>${safe(x.title)}</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>`).join('')}</div></section></div></article>
<aside class="desk-paper desk-exam"><header class="desk-panel-title desk-right-title"><span aria-hidden="true">◎</span><h2>Exam Points &amp; Traps</h2></header><div class="desk-paper-inner">${rightPoints(o)}<section class="desk-card desk-acronyms"><h3><span class="desk-marker">Aa</span>Acronyms explained</h3>${acr.length?`<dl>${acr.map(([a,v])=>`<div><dt>${safe(a)}</dt><dd>${safe(v)}</dd></div>`).join('')}</dl>`:'<p>No abbreviations used in this objective.</p>'}</section>
${additionalReferences(o)}${depthSources(o)}<div class="desk-source"><a href="${safe(D.officialUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Official CISSP exam outline ↗</a></div></div></aside></div>
<div class="desk-bottom"><button data-desk-action="prev" ${i===0?'disabled':''}>← Previous</button><button data-desk-action="full-reader">Open original full notebook</button><button data-desk-action="next" ${i===objectives.length-1?'disabled':''}>Next →</button></div></div>`}
function open(code,push=true){if(!byCode[code])return;if(push&&current!==code)backstack.push(current);current=code;currentQuestion=0;selected=null;revealed=false;topicOpen=null;caseFamily=null;removed=new Set();selfReason='';recallRevealed=false;domainSearch='';const q=scoreContext(currentObj())[0];selfReason=q?(reasonDrafts[q.id]||''):'';persist();window.CISSP_GO('study');window.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'instant'})}
function openDomain(id){const d=D.domains.find(d=>d.id===Number(id));if(!d)return;open(d.objectives[0][0])}
function input(e){if(e.target.id==='desk-select-objective'){open(e.target.value)}else if(e.target.id==='desk-select-domain'){openDomain(e.target.value)}}
function clicks(e){let b=e.target.closest('[data-desk-action]');if(!b)return;let act=b.dataset.deskAction,code=b.dataset.code;
switch(act){case 'precision-grade':{
  if(!/^(?:precision-\d+|d[345]-clinic-\d{3}|final45-\d{3})$/.test(code)||!['apply','review'].includes(b.dataset.grade))break;
  precisionGrades[code]=b.dataset.grade;precisionSave();
  const item=b.closest('.precision-card');if(item){const badge=item.querySelector('.precision-state');if(badge){badge.className='precision-state '+b.dataset.grade;badge.textContent=b.dataset.grade==='apply'?'✓ Can defend':'Review needed';}item.querySelectorAll('[data-desk-action="precision-grade"]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.grade===b.dataset.grade))}
  const items=PRECISION[current]||[],mastered=items.filter(x=>precisionGrades[x.id]==='apply').length;
  const score=document.querySelector('.precision-score');if(score)score.innerHTML=mastered+'/'+items.length+'<small>Can defend</small>';
  const bar=document.querySelector('.precision-meter i');if(bar)bar.style.width=(100*mastered/Math.max(items.length,1))+'%';break;
 }case 'precision-test':{
  const all=scoreContext(currentObj());const i=all.findIndex(q=>q.id===code);if(i<0)break;
  currentQuestion=i;resetQuestion();window.CISSP_RENDER();document.getElementById('desk-active-question')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});break;
 }case 'jump-precision':{
  const item=document.querySelectorAll('#desk-precision .precision-card')[Number(code)];if(item){item.open=true;item.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});}break;
 }case 'application-grade':{const grade=b.dataset.grade;if(['review','apply'].includes(grade)&&/^\d+\.\d+:\d+$/.test(code)){applicationGrades[code]=grade;saveApplication();const item=b.closest('.app-concept');if(item){const badge=item.querySelector('.app-status');if(badge){badge.className='app-status '+grade;badge.textContent=grade==='apply'?'✓ Can apply':'↺ Review';}item.querySelectorAll('[data-desk-action="application-grade"]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.grade===grade));}const arr=MODULE_APPLICATION[current]||[],n=arr.filter((_,i)=>applicationGrades[current+':'+i]==='apply').length;const counter=document.querySelector('.app-progress');if(counter)counter.innerHTML=n+' / '+arr.length+'<small>Can apply</small>';const bar=document.querySelector('.app-progress-track i');if(bar)bar.style.width=(n*100/Math.max(arr.length,1))+'%';}break;}case 'depth-grade':{const grade=b.dataset.grade;if(['review','explain','apply'].includes(grade)&&/^\d+\.\d+:\d+$/.test(code)){depthGrades[code]=grade;saveDepth();const item=b.closest('.desk-depth-item');if(item){const badge=item.querySelector('.desk-depth-badge');if(badge){badge.className='desk-depth-badge '+grade;badge.textContent=grade==='apply'?'✓ Can apply':grade==='explain'?'Can explain':'Need review';}item.querySelectorAll('[data-desk-action=depth-grade]').forEach(btn=>{const active=btn.dataset.grade===grade;btn.classList.toggle('active',active);btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(active));});}const vals=DEPTH[current]||[],count=vals.filter((x,i)=>depthGrades[current+':'+i]==='apply').length;const progress=document.querySelector('.desk-depth-progress');if(progress)progress.innerHTML=count+'/'+vals.length+'<small>Can apply</small>';const meter=document.querySelector('.desk-depth-track i');if(meter)meter.style.width=(count/Math.max(1,vals.length)*100)+'%';}break;}case 'back':{let code=backstack.pop();if(code)open(code,false);break}case 'open':open(code);break;case 'domain':openDomain(code);break;case 'next':open(objectives[Math.min(objectives.length-1,objectives.findIndex(o=>o.code===current)+1)].code);break;case 'prev':open(objectives[Math.max(0,objectives.findIndex(o=>o.code===current)-1)].code);break;
case 'answer':if(!revealed){selected=Number(code);removed.delete(selected);window.CISSP_RENDER()}break;
case 'eliminate':if(!revealed){let n=Number(code);if(removed.has(n))removed.delete(n);else {removed.add(n);if(selected===n)selected=null;}window.CISSP_RENDER()}break;
case 'family':caseFamily=caseFamily===Number(code)?null:Number(code);window.CISSP_RENDER();break;
case 'rate':if(revealed){const q=scoreContext(currentObj())[currentQuestion];if(q){reviewScores[q.id]=code;persist();window.CISSP_RENDER()}}break;
case 'check':if(selected!==null){revealed=true;const q=scoreContext(currentObj())[currentQuestion]||scoreContext(currentObj())[0];window.CISSP_SAVE_DESK_ANSWER?.(q.id,selected===q.correct,selected); window.CISSP_RENDER()}break;
case 'other-question':{let allq=scoreContext(currentObj());if(allq.length>1){currentQuestion=(currentQuestion+1)%allq.length;resetQuestion();window.CISSP_RENDER();document.getElementById('desk-active-question')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'})}else{const nextq=D.scenarios.find(q=>q.domain===currentObj().domain&&q.obj!==currentObj().code);if(nextq)open(nextq.obj)}}break;
case 'topic':topicOpen=topicOpen===Number(code)?null:Number(code);window.CISSP_RENDER();break;
case 'jump-app':{const item=document.querySelectorAll('#desk-application .app-concept')[Number(code)];if(item){item.open=true;item.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});}break;}case 'jump':{document.getElementById(code)?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});break;}
case 'recall-reveal':{recallRevealed=!recallRevealed;window.CISSP_RENDER();break;}
case 'recall-grade':{recallScores[current]=code;persist();window.CISSP_RENDER();break;}
case 'revisit':{revisit[current]=!revisit[current];persist();window.CISSP_RENDER();break;}
case 'retry':{resetQuestion();window.CISSP_RENDER();document.getElementById('desk-active-question')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});break;}
case 'full-reader':window.CISSP_StudyNotes.open(current);break;
case 'bookmarks':window.CISSP_GO('notes');break;
case 'exam':{window.CISSP_GO('simulator');document.querySelector(`button[data-action="exam-domain"][data-id="${code}"]`)?.click();break}
case 'contrast':window.CISSP_GO('contrasts');break;
}}
document.addEventListener('click',clicks);
document.addEventListener('change',input);
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.matches?.('.precision-draft')){const key=e.target.dataset.precisionNote;if(/^(?:precision-\d+|d[345]-clinic-\d{3}|final45-\d{3})$/.test(key||'')){precisionDrafts[key]=e.target.value;precisionSave();}}else if(e.target.matches?.('.app-answer')){const key=e.target.dataset.applicationKey;if(/^\d+\.\d+:\d+$/.test(key||'')){applicationDrafts[key]=e.target.value;saveApplicationDrafts();}}else if(e.target.id==='desk-recall-draft'){recallDrafts[current]=e.target.value;persist()}else if(e.target.id==='desk-my-reason'){selfReason=e.target.value;const q=scoreContext(currentObj())[currentQuestion];if(q){reasonDrafts[q.id]=selfReason;persist()}}});
function openQuestion(id){const q=D.scenarios.find(q=>q.id===id);if(!q)return false;open(q.obj);const i=scoreContext(currentObj()).findIndex(x=>x.id===id);if(i<0)return false;currentQuestion=i;resetQuestion();window.CISSP_RENDER();document.getElementById('desk-active-question')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return true;}
window.CISSP_StudyDesk={render:body,open,openDomain,openQuestion,current:()=>current, objectives,expansion,maps};
})();

</script>
  <script>
/* app.js */
(() => {
'use strict';
const D = window.CISSP_DATA;
const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
const esc = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
const letters = ['A','B','C','D'];
const navigation = D.domains.map(d=>[String(d.id),String(d.id),d.title]);
const topNav = [['study','Study'],['reference','Rapid lookup'],['notes','Search'],['contrasts','Compare'],['scenarios','Questions'],['simulator','Mock exam'],['progress','Progress'],['dashboard','Overview']];
const key = 'cissp-decision-lab-v1';
let saved = {};
try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||'{}')||{}}catch(e){saved={}}
const state = {page:'study',domain:1,lesson:'l1',selected:null,scenarioId:'q101',filter:'all',submitted:false,reasoning:'',keywordFilter:'all',trap:0,pivot:0,pivotSide:0,query:'',exam:null,practiceLength:25,practiceDomain:'all',practiceMode:'all',scenarioSearch:''};
const data = {lessons: saved.lessons||{},answers:saved.answers||{},notes:saved.notes||{}, review:saved.review||{},started:saved.started||new Date().toISOString()};
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(data))}catch(e){}}
function lessonsFor(id){return D.lessons.filter(l=>l.domain===Number(id))}
function scenariosFor(filter){let list=filter==='all'?D.scenarios:D.scenarios.filter(q=>q.domain===Number(filter));let query=(state.scenarioSearch||'').trim().toLowerCase();return !query?list:list.filter(q=>[q.obj,q.title,q.stem,q.trap,q.principle,...q.options.flat()].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query))}
function domain(id){return D.domains.find(d=>d.id===Number(id))||D.domains[0]}
function lesson(id){return D.lessons.find(l=>l.id===id)||D.lessons[0]}
function scenario(id){return D.scenarios.find(q=>q.id===id)||D.scenarios[0]}
function completed(){return Object.values(data.lessons).filter(s=>s==='mastered').length}
function answered(){return Object.values(data.answers).length}
function accuracy(){let arr=Object.values(data.answers);return arr.length?Math.round(arr.filter(a=>a.correct).length/arr.length*100):0}
function domainProgress(id){let l=lessonsFor(id);return Math.round(l.filter(x=>data.lessons[x.id]==='mastered').length/(l.length||1)*100)}
function btn(label, action, id='', cls=''){return `<button type="button" class="btn ${cls}" data-action="${esc(action)}" data-id="${esc(id)}">${label}</button>`}
function pageHeader(tag,title,lead){return `<header class="page-header"><div class="eyebrow">${esc(tag)}</div><h2>${esc(title)}</h2><p class="lead">${esc(lead)}</p></header>`}
function domainCard(d){return `<button class="domain-card" data-action="domain" data-id="${d.id}" aria-label="Open domain ${d.id}, ${esc(d.title)}">
  <div class="domain-head"><span class="domain-icon" style="color:${d.color}">${d.icon}</span><span class="domain-weight">${d.weight}% EXAM</span></div>
  <h3>${d.id.toString().padStart(2,'0')} · ${esc(d.title)}</h3><p>${esc(d.purpose)}</p>
  <div class="row between tiny"><span>${lessonsFor(d.id).filter(x=>data.lessons[x.id]==='mastered').length}/${lessonsFor(d.id).length} starter lessons marked understood</span><span>${domainProgress(d.id)}%</span></div><div class="mini-progress"><i style="width:${domainProgress(d.id)}%"></i></div></button>`}
function lessonCard(l){let status=data.lessons[l.id]||'not started';return `<button class="lesson-card" data-action="lesson" data-id="${l.id}"><div class="row between"><span class="pill">Objective ${esc(l.obj)}</span><span class="lesson-status ${status==='mastered'?'ok-note':status==='review'?'review-note':''}">${status==='mastered'?'✓ UNDERSTOOD':status==='review'?'↺ REVIEW AGAIN':'START LESSON'}</span></div><h3>${esc(l.title)}</h3><p>${esc(l.summary)}</p></button>`}
function dashboard(){let first=Object.keys(data.lessons).length?D.lessons.find(l=>!data.lessons[l.id]||data.lessons[l.id]==='review')||D.lessons[0]:D.lessons[0];
return `<div class="hero"><div><div class="eyebrow">THE HANDWRITTEN CISSP STUDY DESK • 2026</div><h2>CISSP 2026<br/><strong class="accent">Master Notebook</strong></h2><p>Read the concept. Work the example. Make the decision. Check the reasoning.</p>
  <div class="hero-actions">${btn('Explore 62 objectives →','notes','','primary')}${btn('See 40 visual contrasts →','contrasts','','quiet')}${btn('Practice ${D.scenarios.length} cases','scenarios','','quiet')}</div></div>
  <div class="hero-orbit"><div class="orbit-ring"><div class="orbit-inner"><b>8</b><span>domains<br/>one mindset</span></div></div></div></div>
  <div class="kicker"><h3>Notes from your study desk</h3><span class="tiny">Saved on this device, not in a cloud account</span></div>
  <div class="cards-4"><div class="stat-card"><span class="stat-icon">✎</span><strong>62</strong><small>Expanded handwritten objective notes</small></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><span class="stat-icon">◉</span><strong>${answered()}<small> / ${D.scenarios.length}</small></strong><small>Distinct scenario questions attempted</small></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><span class="stat-icon">◎</span><strong>${answered()?accuracy()+'%':'—'}</strong><small>Latest-attempt accuracy</small></div>
    <div class="stat-card"><span class="stat-icon">▤</span><strong>${completed()}<small> / ${D.lessons.length}</small></strong><small>Starter lessons self-rated</small></div></div>
  <div class="kicker"><h3>Eight hand-drawn domain notebooks</h3>${btn('View full syllabus','domains','','small quiet')}</div>
  <div class="cards-4">${D.domains.map(domainCard).join('')}</div>
  <div class="kicker"><h3>The eight handwritten decision steps</h3></div>
  <div class="section-grid"><div class="panel"><h3>My exam-thinking notes</h3>${stepList()}</div><div class="panel"><h3>Start with a real scenario</h3><p>Choose your action, write why you think it is right, and uncover explanations for <b>all four</b> options.</p><div class="note-paper-box">“What would I do FIRST — and why not the other three?”</div><div class="actions">${btn('Try a challenge →','scenarios','','primary')}</div><div class="separator"></div><p class="tiny">This is an original learning prototype, not a full commercial question bank or a simulation of ISC2's adaptive scoring.</p></div></div>`}
const compassSteps=[['Role','Who is responsible for the decision?'],['Objective','What outcome actually matters?'],['Keyword','Is it FIRST, BEST, MOST, NEXT or EXCEPT?'],['Stage','Are we designing, operating or responding?'],['Authority','Who may approve, implement or accept risk?'],['Constraints','Consider safety, law, business and impact.'],['Eliminate','What is premature, unauthorised or off-target?'],['Defend','Why is this better than the strongest alternative?']];
function stepList(){return compassSteps.map((s,i)=>`<div class="guide-step"><span class="step-no">${i+1}</span><div><strong>${s[0]}</strong><p>${s[1]}</p></div></div>`).join('')}
function domainsView(){return `${pageHeader('The exam blueprint','Eight domains. One connected body of knowledge.','Explore the current syllabus. Each domain shows its official objective codes in a paraphrased coverage map, available starter lessons and original scenarios.')}
<div class="cards-4">${D.domains.map(domainCard).join('')}</div><div class="panel" style="margin-top:18px"><b>Syllabus validity</b><p class="tiny">Current CISSP outline effective 15 April 2024; a revised outline is scheduled for 15 April 2027. Domain names, weights and objective codes are taken from ISC2. The learning summaries and practice questions here are independently authored. <a href="${D.officialUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Check the official outline ↗</a></p></div>`}
function domainView(){let d=domain(state.domain);return `<button class="back" data-action="domains">← All domains</button>${pageHeader(`DOMAIN ${d.id} / ${d.weight}% OF EXAM`,d.title,d.purpose)}
<div class="row between" style="margin-bottom:15px"><h3>Learn the essential reasoning</h3><span class="pill">${lessonsFor(d.id).length} interactive starter lessons</span></div><div class="cards-2">${lessonsFor(d.id).map(lessonCard).join('')}</div>
<div class="kicker"><h3>Objective notebook index</h3><span class="tiny">Every heading has a linked study summary; further depth is needed for complete exam preparation</span></div>
<div class="panel"><div class="objective-grid">${d.objectives.map(([code,name])=>`<button type="button" class="objective objective-link" data-notes-action="open" data-code="${code}"><b>${code}</b><span>${esc(name)}</span><small>Open study note →</small></button>`).join('')}</div></div>
<div class="actions">${btn('Complete domain challenge journal →','casebook-domain',d.id,'primary')}${btn('Try multiple-choice scenarios →','scenario-domain',d.id,'quiet')}${btn('Back to dashboard','dashboard','','quiet')}</div>`}
function renderPaper(l){return `<div class="paper"><div class="row between"><div><div class="pen-sub">✎ Handwritten concept map · ${esc(l.obj)}</div><h3>${esc(l.title)}</h3></div><span style="font-size:25px">✎</span></div><div class="sketch">${l.nodes.map((n,i)=>`${i?'<span class="sketch-arrow">→</span>':''}<div class="sketch-node">${esc(n)}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="pen-sub" style="margin-top:28px">✦ Pen note: What is the requirement — and who has the authority to decide?</div></div>`}
function lessonView(){let l=lesson(state.lesson);let d=domain(l.domain);let note=data.notes[l.id]||'';let ordered=lessonsFor(l.domain);let idx=ordered.findIndex(x=>x.id===l.id);let status=data.lessons[l.id]||'';
return `<button class="back" data-action="domain" data-id="${d.id}">← Domain ${d.id}: ${esc(d.short)}</button>
${pageHeader(`CONCEPT NOTEBOOK • OBJECTIVE ${l.obj}`,l.title,l.summary)}
<div class="lesson-layout"><div class="stack">${renderPaper(l)}<div class="panel"><h3>✎ The explanation, in plain words</h3><p class="lesson-body">${esc(l.summary)}</p><div class="insight"><b>Why it matters in a scenario</b><p>${esc(l.why)}</p></div><div class="insight warn"><b>Trap to avoid</b><p>${esc(l.trap)}</p></div><div class="insight"><b>Real-world example</b><p>${esc(l.example)}</p></div></div></div>
<div class="stack"><div class="panel"><div class="eyebrow">TEACH IT BACK</div><h3>Write it in your own words</h3><p>Explain this concept in your own words. Think of a situation when it is the best choice and one when it is not.</p>
<label class="reasoning-lbl" for="study-note">Your private explanation</label><textarea id="study-note" class="note-area" placeholder="My explanation, a comparison and one practical example…">${esc(note)}</textarea>
<div class="actions">${btn('Save explanation','save-note','','small')}${btn('Print note ↗','print','','quiet small')}</div></div>
<div class="panel"><h3>My confidence check</h3><p class="tiny">This is your own rating, not proof of tested mastery. Scenario performance is measured separately.</p><div class="actions">${btn(status==='mastered'?'✓ Marked understood':'I understand this','mark-understood',l.id,'primary small')}${btn('Review again','mark-review',l.id,'small')}</div></div>
<div class="panel"><h3>Sketch it into a decision</h3><p>Move from knowledge to judgement with a scenario connected to this lesson.</p><div class="actions">${btn('Practice a related scenario →','related-scenario',l.id,'primary')}</div></div>
${idx+1<ordered.length?`<div class="panel"><h4>Next concept</h4><p>${esc(ordered[idx+1].title)}</p>${btn('Next notebook page →','lesson',ordered[idx+1].id,'small')}</div>`:''}</div></div>`}
function scenarioView(){let list=scenariosFor(state.filter);if(!list.length)return `${pageHeader('SCENARIO ARENA','Find the question that tests your idea.','Search the complete authored question bank by objective, technical term, case or trap.')}<div class="scenario-search-panel"><input class="search" type="search" id="scenario-search" placeholder="Search scenarios…" value="${esc(state.scenarioSearch)}"/><button class="btn primary" data-action="search-scenarios">Search</button><button class="btn" data-action="clear-scenario-search">Clear filters</button></div><div class="panel"><h3>No matching scenarios</h3><p>Try a broader phrase or clear the filters.</p></div>`;let q=scenario(state.scenarioId);if(!list.includes(q)){q=list[0];state.scenarioId=q.id}let index=list.findIndex(a=>a.id===q.id);let chosen=state.selected;let answeredNow=state.submitted;let chosenRight=chosen===q.correct;let linked=lesson(q.lesson);
return `${pageHeader('SCENARIO ARENA','Think first. Choose second. Defend always.','These are original, deliberately tricky CISSP-style learning scenarios—not real ISC2 exam questions. Compare timing, role, business impact and controls.')}
<div class="filter-bar"><button class="chip ${state.filter==='all'?'active':''}" data-action="filter-domain" data-id="all">All domains</button>${D.domains.map(d=>`<button class="chip ${state.filter===String(d.id)?'active':''}" data-action="filter-domain" data-id="${d.id}">D${d.id} · ${d.short}</button>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="scenario-search-panel"><input class="search" type="search" id="scenario-search" placeholder="Search ${D.scenarios.length} questions · keyword, concept, objective…" value="${esc(state.scenarioSearch)}" aria-label="Search scenarios"/><button class="btn primary" data-action="search-scenarios">Find</button><button class="btn quiet" data-action="clear-scenario-search">Clear</button><span class="tiny">${list.length} matching questions</span></div>
<div class="scenario-layout"><div class="scenario-card"><div class="row between"><span class="pill">DOMAIN ${q.domain} · ${esc(q.obj)}</span><span class="pill">DIFFICULTY ${'★'.repeat(q.level)}${'☆'.repeat(5-q.level)}</span></div><h3>${esc(q.title)}</h3><p class="scenario-stem">${esc(q.stem)}</p>
<div class="row between"><span class="eyebrow">Choose the ${q.keyword} answer</span><span class="counter">QUESTION ${index+1} / ${list.length}</span></div>
${q.options.map(([answer],i)=>`<button type="button" data-action="pick-answer" data-id="${i}" ${answeredNow?'disabled':''} class="answer-option ${chosen===i?'selected':''} ${answeredNow?'reveal '+(i===q.correct?'correct':chosen===i?'wrong':''):''}"><span class="answer-letter">${letters[i]}</span><span>${esc(answer)}</span></button>`).join('')}
${!answeredNow?`<div class="separator"></div><label class="reasoning-lbl" for="scenario-reason">Your reasoning (at least 12 characters before checking)</label><textarea id="scenario-reason" class="reasoning" placeholder="What makes this the best answer? Which tempting alternative is wrong?">${esc(state.reasoning)}</textarea>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn primary" data-action="check-answer" ${chosen===null||state.reasoning.trim().length<12?'disabled':''} id="check-answer">Reveal detailed reasoning →</button></div>`:
`<div class="feedback ${chosenRight?'':'wrong'}"><h4>${chosenRight?'✓ Strong decision':'↺ Recalibrate your thinking'} · Correct answer ${letters[q.correct]}</h4>
<p>${esc(q.principle)}</p><div class="pill">TRAP · ${esc(q.trap)}</div><div style="margin-top:17px">${q.options.map(([answer,why],i)=>`<div class="feedback-item"><b>${letters[i]} ${i===q.correct?'· Why this wins':i===chosen?'· Why your choice loses':'· Why it loses'}</b><p>${esc(why)}</p></div>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="insight"><b>Reconsider your original reasoning</b><p>${esc(state.reasoning)}</p></div><div class="actions">${btn('Next unseen scenario →','next-scenario','','primary')}${btn('Review underlying concept','lesson',linked.id,'small')}</div></div>`}
</div><div class="stack"><div class="panel"><div class="eyebrow">THE JUDGEMENT CHECK</div><h3>Handwritten decision checklist</h3>${stepList()}</div><div class="panel"><h3>My question notes</h3><div class="meter"><i style="width:${(index+1)/list.length*100}%"></i></div><p class="tiny">Current question ${index+1} of ${list.length} in this filter. Learning mode allows revisiting questions.</p><div class="separator"></div><p class="tiny">The answer explanations are locked until you make a choice and state your reasoning.</p></div></div></div>`}
function trapsView(){let item=D.traps[state.trap];return `${pageHeader('TRAP DECODER','Know why a tempting answer is wrong.','Real exam difficulty often comes from conflicting priorities and precise wording—not obscure terminology.')}
<div class="cards-3">${D.traps.map((t,i)=>`<button class="trap-card" data-action="select-trap" data-id="${i}" style="${state.trap===i?'border-color:#2f8378;background:#ddf3dd':''}"><span class="eyebrow">TRAP ${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><h3>${esc(t[0])}</h3><small>Open the explanation →</small></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="panel" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="eyebrow">DECISION RULE</div><h3>${esc(item[0])}</h3><p class="lesson-body">${esc(item[1])}</p><div class="note-paper-box">“How would the correct answer change if the role, timing or objective changed?”</div></div>`}
function pivotsView(){let p=D.pivots[state.pivot];let changed=state.pivotSide===1;return `${pageHeader('WHAT-IF LAB','Change one fact. Change the right answer.','A powerful antidote to memorising shortcuts. Watch how context—not a familiar buzzword—determines the defensible action.')}
<div class="cards-4" style="margin-bottom:16px">${D.pivots.map((it,i)=>`<button class="trap-card" data-action="select-pivot" data-id="${i}" style="${state.pivot===i?'border-color:var(--mint)':''}"><span class="eyebrow">DOMAIN ${it.domain}</span><h3>${esc(it.title)}</h3><small>${esc(it.variable)}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>
<div class="panel"><div class="row between" style="flex-wrap:wrap"><div><div class="eyebrow">THE VARIABLE · ${esc(p.variable)}</div><h3>${esc(p.title)}</h3></div><span class="pill">${changed?'CASE B':'CASE A'}</span></div>
<div class="note-paper-box" style="margin:18px 0">${esc(changed?p.after:p.before)}</div><h4>Most defensible response</h4><p class="lesson-body">${esc(changed?p.afterChoice:p.beforeChoice)}</p>
<div class="actions">${btn(changed?'← Switch to case A':'Change the key fact →','flip-pivot','','primary')}</div>
<div class="insight" style="margin-top:23px"><b>What changed — and why it matters</b><p>${esc(p.why)}</p></div></div>`}
function glossaryView(){return `${pageHeader('KEYWORD VAULT','The words that change the answer.','Master exam directives and closely related concepts. Search any term, use contrast to strengthen recall, and return before mock exams.')}
<div class="row between" style="margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap"><input id="glossary-search" class="search" value="${esc(state.query)}" placeholder="Search FIRST, RPO, ABAC, SAST…" aria-label="Search glossary"/><span class="tiny">${D.glossary.length} term cards in this starter vault</span></div><div class="panel" id="glossary-list">${glossaryRows()}</div>`}
function glossaryRows(){let q=state.query.trim().toLowerCase();let words=D.glossary.filter(x=>x.join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));return words.length?words.map(([term,definition,cat])=>`<div class="term-row"><b>${esc(term)}</b><span>${esc(definition)}</span><small>${esc(cat)}</small></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">No matching term. Try a shorter phrase.</div>'}
function compassView(){return `${pageHeader('YOUR MENTAL MODEL','The CISSP thinking compass','Use this sequence on every question. It is a reasoning discipline, not a set of universal shortcuts or a guarantee of a correct result.')}
<div class="section-grid"><div class="panel"><img class="compass" src="data:image/png;base64,
